newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein easier in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein easier in light trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were easier in late trading on Wednesday on limited buying interest, traders said.
They said palm olein was generally quoted at 1,430-35 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,435-40 rupiah at the opening, but some offers were also heard at 1,440 rupiah.
Crude palm oil was last done at 1,252.15 rupiah/kg at a 500-tonne tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan on Tuesday, compared with 1,281 rupiah previously.
"The market weakened in the second session, with buyers mostly at the sidelines," one trader said.
Traders said there was still some refining margin at the current level of crude palm oil prices, but added that olein prices were showing signs of weakening further.
"Some big players are selling at the lower end of the market range, putting pressure on others," one said.
Data from Belawan Port showed the K.M. Permanan will leave today for Semarang with 1,800 tonnes of olein. The MT Pasaban will leave for Jakarta on Thursday with 1,000 tonnes of olein.
